mainTitle: 🎯 Harassment Against the User: Systematic and Coordinated Persecution
mainDescription: Complete documentation of systematic harassment — This article documents in detail the coordinated and systematic harassment suffered by the user WazzimaGiygg (Pedro Henrique Cardona Peres) by Lusophone Wikipedia administrators and checkusers, including wikihounding, doxxing, stalking, abuse of power and persecution across multiple platforms.
section1Title: 1. Introduction: Harassment as a Tool of Control
section1Text1: The WazzimaGiygg case represents one of the most serious examples of institutional harassment documented on digital platforms. What began as personal persecution evolved into a coordinated harassment system involving multiple administrators and checkusers, using moderation tools as weapons to silence and destroy the reputation of a critical user.
objective1: • Document all forms of harassment suffered
objective2: • Map the timeline of systematic harassment
objective3: • Identify the agents involved in each act of harassment
objective5: • Establish parameters for identifying institutional harassment
warningHarassmentText: The harassment against WazzimaGiygg was not an isolated incident, but a coordinated persecution system involving multiple agents with institutional power. The case reveals a pattern of institutionalized harassment where moderation tools are used as weapons of persecution.
sub2_1Text1: Definition: Wikihounding is the systematic persecution of a user across the platform, monitoring their edits, contributions and activities to justify arbitrary sanctions.
wikihoundingWarningText: Chronus publicly admitted to obsessively monitoring the user's external profiles to justify arbitrary sanctions. This public confession is conclusive proof of wikihounding, which constitutes institutional harassment and abuse of power.
sub2_2Text1: Definition: Doxxing is the public exposure of an individual's personal data without their consent, with the aim of causing damage to their reputation, privacy and security.
doxxingList: Exposed data: Civil name "Pedro Henrique Cardona Peres"
Consequence: Permanent SEO damage - second result on Google
Aggravating factor: Indexable and permanently available logs
doxxingNoteText: The exposure of the civil name "Pedro Henrique Cardona Peres" in indexable public logs constitutes doxxing in its most serious form. The damage is permanent and irreversible, as the logs remain indexed in search engines, destroying the victim's professional and personal reputation.
sub2_3Text1: Definition: Stalking is the repeated persecution of a person, monitoring their life and activities, causing fear, anxiety and psychological damage.

stalkingTable.description: Wikipedia, Wikimedia Commons, Skyscrapercity, social media

stalkingWarningText: The repeated persecution across multiple platforms, with monitoring of the victim's personal life, constitutes aggravated stalking (crime committed via the internet). Chronus's public confession is conclusive proof of the crime.
sub2_4Text1: Definition: Institutional abuse of power is the misuse of administrative tools and privileges to persecute, intimidate or harm users.
poderList: Agents: Chronus, Edmond Dantès, Little Sunshine, Johannesn89
Abused tools: CheckUser (verification), global block, IP logs
poderInsightText: The use of moderation tools (CheckUser, global block) for personal persecution, and not for platform protection, constitutes institutional abuse of power. The coordination between multiple agents aggravates the abuse, transforming it into systemic institutional harassment.
sub2_5Text1: Definition: Moral harassment is the exposure of a person to humiliating, embarrassing and offensive situations, causing damage to their dignity and mental health.
moralList: Aggravating factor: Public humiliation on a global platform

timelineTable.action: Admission of off-wiki monitoring. Linked the WazzimaGiygg account to Pedro Henrique Peres's civil name.
Global block in 4 minutes ("4-Minute Log") without adversarial proceedings.
Opens request against "Senhorvinte", exposing the user's personal name.
Replies "Possible, difficult to prove with certainty" - technical validation of persecution.
Moves the request and "confirms" in 6 hours what was only "possible".
Formal complaint of Doxxing and use of device fingerprinting.

timelineWarningText: The timeline reveals a continuous pattern of harassment extending over more than 8 months, with intensification at critical moments. The harassment was not an isolated incident, but a systematic and coordinated process of persecution.
sub4_1Text1: The "Little Sunshine" pattern documents the systemic coordination to harass the user:
step1Text: Chronus initiates false narrative against the user
step2Text: Edmond Dantès says "Possible, difficult to prove"
step3Text: Little Sunshine "confirms" in 6 hours what was only "possible"
step4Text: Sanction applied in 4 minutes, without adversarial proceedings

cycleTable.description: Victim is removed from the community

intimidationList: Intimidation through speed: 4-minute block to prevent any defense.
Intimidation through exposure: Doxxing of the civil name to destroy reputation.
Intimidation through coordination: Multiple agents acting together.
Intimidation through silence: Absence of appeal mechanisms.
Intimidation through impunity: No agent suffers consequences.
section5Title: 5. Consequences of Harassment for the Victim
professionalList: SEO damage: The name "Pedro Henrique Cardona Peres" appears as the second result on Google associated with false accusations.
Professional harm: Employers, clients and partners are exposed to false information.
Blocking of new opportunities: The destroyed reputation prevents new professional opportunities.
Career damage: The association with false accusations permanently harms the career.
professionalWarningText: The doxxing of the civil name and the resulting SEO damage create permanent professional harm. Anyone who searches for the victim's name finds the doxxing log, destroying their professional and personal reputation in an irreversible manner.
personalList: Psychological damage: Anxiety, stress, feeling of permanent persecution.
Social isolation: The victim is excluded from the community they actively contributed to.
Image damage: Permanent association with false accusations.
Mental health damage: Continuous harassment causes deep psychological harm.
Work devaluation: Legitimate contributions are used as "proof" for persecution.
paradoxText1: The user contributed high-quality content to the platform (photographs, edits). These legitimate contributions were used as "proof" to persecute him. This is not just a privacy violation, but an attack on the victim's identity and work — a way of saying "no matter what good you do, you will be punished".
paradoxText2: This paradox reveals the cruelty of institutional harassment: the victim is punished not for their mistakes, but for their successes.

responsibilityTable.harassment: Subsidiary liability for failing to prevent harassment

legalTable.penalty: Fine up to R$ 50 million + compensation

legalTable.device: Injury (Art. 140 of Penal Code) + Moral damage

section8Title: 8. 📢 Recommendations for Prevention and Combating Harassment
platformRecommendations: Clear anti-harassment policies: Define and rigorously enforce harassment prevention policies.
Independent complaint channels: Mechanisms for harassment complaints not controlled by aggressors.
Impartial investigation: Harassment complaints must be investigated by independent third parties.
Real consequences: Effective punishments for administrators who commit harassment.
Harassment prevention training: Mandatory training for all administrators.
Transparency in actions: Publication of all administrative actions with protection of sensitive data.
victimRecommendations: Complete documentation: Record all evidence and timeline of harassment.
Seek support: Look for other victims and support communities.
Legal assistance: Consult lawyers specialized in digital law.
Report to authorities: Notify ANPD, Public Prosecutor's Office and other authorities.
Mental health preservation: Seek professional psychological support.
Do not stay silent: Report harassment publicly to expose the aggressors.
communityRecommendations: Collective vigilance: The community must monitor and report harassment patterns.
Support for victims: Offer support and solidarity to harassment victims.
Collaborative documentation: Record harassment cases to build evidence.
Pressure for reforms: Demand structural changes to prevent harassment.
Do not normalize abuse: Question harassment patterns when identified.
section9Title: 9. 📢 Call to Action: End of Institutional Harassment
callToActionList: Immediate Demotion: Removal of Chronus, Edmond Dantès, Little Sunshine and Johannesn89 from all administrative positions.
Criminal Investigation: Opening of police inquiry to investigate the crimes of stalking, doxxing and criminal association.
Civil Investigation: Civil action for moral and material damages against all agents involved.
Administrative Investigation: Inquiry at the Wikimedia Foundation to investigate UCoC violations.
Notification to ANPD: Formal complaint for LGPD violations.
Content Removal: LGPD take-down of all exposed personal data.
Structural Reform: Implementation of rigorous harassment prevention policies.
Mandatory Training: Training of all administrators in harassment prevention.
section10Title: 10. Conclusion: The Urgency of Combating Harassment
finalText1: The WazzimaGiygg case reveals a system of institutional harassment deeply rooted in Lusophone Wikipedia governance. The harassment was not an isolated incident, but a coordinated pattern involving multiple agents with institutional power.
finalText2: The documented forms of harassment — wikihounding, doxxing, stalking, abuse of power, moral harassment — constitute crimes against honor, against personal liberty and against privacy. The coordination between agents aggravates the harassment, transforming it into systemic institutional harassment.
finalText3: Combating institutional harassment requires concrete and immediate measures: demotion of involved agents, criminal and civil investigation, structural reform and implementation of rigorous prevention policies.
finalText4: The impunity of harassers is not acceptable. Silence in the face of harassment is complicity. It is time to break the silence and demand justice.
